facts.fact: TechCentral reports Huawei said on 5 March 2019 that Huawei Cloud is now available in South Africa, with localised public cloud services deployed from a Johannesburg data centre.
Huawei is leasing a data centre in Johannesburg from an unnamed partner from which it runs public cloud services, announced 5 March 2019.

Huawei states its South African (Johannesburg) data centre, leased from an unnamed partner and in service from March 2019, complies with tier 3+ standards; this is the operator's own statement, not a certification.
